title: Two-level assessment of the value of market microstructure information for implied volatility estimation and delta-hedging of Bitcoin options: code and derived data
description: Code, derived results and figures for the article by I. Kistin and Sh. Isaev. The pipeline downloads public Binance BTCUSDT option (EOHSummary) and spot data for September-October 2023, verifies them by SHA-256, estimates implied volatility with five models under leakage control, backtests hourly delta hedging with six rebalancing rules (hourly, Leland, fixed threshold, fixed band, Whalley-Wilmott band, adaptive threshold) and regenerates every number, table and figure of the article. Release v2.0.0 supersedes v1.0.0.
